preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 1000.
The data of each node in the binary tree must be between 1 and 10000.
The target node value must be between 1 and 10000.
The distance k must be between 1 and 20.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sorted([node for node in nodes_at_distance_k])
postconditions.description: The output must be a sorted list of nodes at distance k from the target node.
